import sys

def main():
    # Read the input character
    char = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    
    if len(char) == 0:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    # Get ASCII value of the lowercase letter
    ascii_lower = ord(char)
    
    # Convert to uppercase using ASCII arithmetic
    # Lowercase letters are in range 97-122 (a-z)
    # Uppercase letters are in range 65-90 (A-Z)
    # Difference is 32
    if 97 <= ascii_lower <= 122:
        ascii_upper = ascii_lower - 32
        result = chr(ascii_upper)
        print(result)
    else:
        print(-1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
